title: Culture Presentation
subject: Social Studies
instructions: Present your family’s culture, a special tradition, or a family recipe.
Presentation must last 1–8 minutes. No food may be distributed to the class, without exception.

Slideshows must use Google Slides and be shared with the teacher at least one day before presenting. No Canva or other sites. A poster is also an option; the rubric allows demonstrations or other formats.
Return the signed top portion of the appointment form tomorrow (relative to the original notice); keep the bottom portion.

Only one parent may attend. Arrive a few minutes early, check in at the front office, wait in the hallway until collected, and do not knock or enter. The parent should not speak more than the child. Parent absence does not affect the grade.
Past examples: Teddy Bear Teas, family heritage in Columbia (as written in the notice), and egg knocking.

Organization: Materials and presentation are not organized.
Content: A lot of knowledge on the topic.

tasks: Choose a family culture, tradition or recipe and presentation format
Gather family facts, pictures or demonstration materials
Organize an introduction, main points and closing
Explain what the tradition is, how it works and why it matters to your family
Prepare neat, ordered visuals or materials
Practice explaining the topic in your own words
Practice speaking clearly and distinctly; child leads
If using Google Slides, share with teacher at least one day early; otherwise mark not applicable
Pack materials and confirm appointment and arrival plan
